briefHtml:
NAV S$10,168,883 - reported -0.74%, real approx -0.07% after restatement

  • Biggest mover: Tencent -3.69% to HK$376.00 (52-week-low zone) into today's earnings; Alibaba -5.21%
  • The one thing: Nvidia smashed it after the bell - Q3 revenue $115.8bn (+103%) vs ~$109bn expected, Q4 guided ~$130bn vs $125bn consensus, backlog now $2.5tn, FY28 outlook raised to 75%; board ruled out reinstating Huang. NVDA +2-4% after hours. The AI-bottleneck deployment trigger has fired.

Markets

  • US Tue: SPX 7,340.53 -1.03%; Dow 50,759.42 -1.64%; Nasdaq 24,328.39 -0.74%; VIX 25.46 +11.1%; 10y ~5.10%; DXY ~103.5
  • Asia Tue: HSI 23,508 -1.03%; Tencent HK$376.00 -3.69%; Alibaba -5.21%; Xiaomi +2.13%; STI 5,109.13 -1.43%; Nikkei -1.34%; KOSPI -2.59%
  • Metals: gold ~$3,840-3,860 (lowest since Sep 2025); silver $47.26 +0.23% (session low $46.83; -59.9% from 52-wk high)
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2884, USDCNY ~6.67

Flags

  • 8 flags; magnitudes shifting as baselines partially reset. Tencent flag (-10.0%) is converging on REAL weakness (HK$376, 52-wk-low shelf, reports today). Silver flags (-5.3%) are artefacts - silver actually rose Tuesday
  • L46.SI Yahoo 404 - 35th session

Insider trades

  • None found (SGX API 404 for the 6th straight trading day; Wing Tai pause 8 sessions; US holdings are ETFs)

Congress trades

  • Filed 11/17: House Republican (FL-19) 8-trade batch - buys IBKR x2; sells NFLX, ZTS, ADSK (x2 each)
  • Filed 11/16: CA-50 sold a $500k-1M US T-Bill; IL-1 bought DDOG, EL and sold BP, SPHR; AR-2 sold JBGS; WA-1 municipal switches
  • Source: Unusual Whales

Trump / policy

  • NVDA Q3: $115.8bn revenue, $2.68 EPS, Q4 guide ~$130bn, $2.5tn backlog, $150bn buyback authorization (approved Sept); board: no Huang reinstatement Press release
  • Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral in Shenzhen Nov 18-19; Busan truce extension the goal; China extended rare-earth pause to Jan 10; chip curbs not on the table NPR
  • BIS remote-access rule names Singapore among diversion-risk countries The Hill
  • FOMC minutes today 2pm ET; Anthropic prices today, trades Thu as ANT; Tencent reports today

Risk

  • Silver line ~1.92x (equity approx S$52,000); silver -59.9% from 52-wk high despite Tuesday's +0.2%
  • VIX 25.46 (intraday 27.73) into a catalyst cluster: FOMC minutes, ANT pricing, summit
  • Gold broke the 3,850-3,875 shelf intraday (low 3,836.96)
  • FX ~35% non-SGD at 1.2884; concentration: HK tech + SGX property; STI -2.3% in two sessions

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • AI bottlenecks - TRIGGER FIRED: beat-and-raise with governance steadying delivered; begin staged deployment of the 15% sleeve from idle cash, first tranche after the AH move settles
  • Asia barbell: Tencent reports at a 52-week low; clean print plus truce extension makes the HK-tech leg actionable
  • Defense: 10y ~5.10%, gate 5.20% 10bp away - deploy AT the gate only

trumpWatch.title: NVDA Q3 smash; board rules out Huang return
trumpWatch.detail: Revenue $115.8bn (+103% y/y) vs about $109bn consensus; non-GAAP EPS $2.68 vs $2.47; Q4 guided $127.4-132.6bn vs $125.25bn consensus; cloud backlog now $2.5tn; FY28 growth outlook raised to 75%. Kress interim CEO; board will not reinstate Huang; new National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee. NVDA +2-4% after hours.

trumpWatch.title: Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral in Shenzhen Nov 18-19
trumpWatch.detail: Trump met Quad leaders in Manila and is to sign a Thailand trade deal en route. Goal is extending the Busan truce expiring in January; China extended its rare-earth export-control pause to Jan 10. Chip curbs explicitly not negotiated.

trumpWatch.title: BIS remote-access chip rule
trumpWatch.detail: Monday interim final rule: licenses for chips to overseas data centers serving restricted countries; Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Brazil named diversion-risk jurisdictions.

trumpWatch.title: FOMC minutes today
trumpWatch.detail: October minutes at 2pm ET Wednesday; Waller floated 50bp for December; a December hike is fully priced, debate is on size.

trumpWatch.title: Anthropic prices IPO today
trumpWatch.detail: 825M shares at $70-$78 (valuation roughly $1.3-1.45tn) price Wednesday after close; ANT trades Thursday, same day as the Trump-Xi bilateral.

trumpWatch.title: Tencent reports today at a 52-week low
trumpWatch.detail: Tencent closed HK$376.00 (-3.69%) Tuesday, near its 52-week low of 375.20, into Wednesday results; Alibaba fell 5.21%. China October data soft: retail sales +0.4% vs +0.8% forecast, industrial production +4.8% vs +5.3%.

opportunities.thesis: AI bottlenecks (target 15%, 0% deployed): pre-committed trigger fired - beat-and-raise ($115.8bn, Q4 guide ~$130bn, $2.5tn backlog) with governance steadying (Kress interim, no Huang return, new oversight committee).
opportunities.signal: Begin staged deployment of the 15% sleeve from the ~62% idle cash; first tranche after the after-hours move settles, not into a gap

opportunities.thesis: Asia barbell (target 10%): Tencent at HK$376 (52-week low, ~13x TTM P/E) reports today - second binary of the week; Alibaba -5.2% shows sentiment is washed out.
opportunities.signal: No pre-print action; clean Tencent print plus truce extension Thursday makes the HK-tech leg actionable at depressed levels

opportunities.thesis: Defense sleeve (target 15%): 10y at ~5.10% is 10bp below the 5.20% gate; FOMC minutes today and the December-size debate keep two-way risk; a risk-on turn could push yields down and the gate out of reach.
opportunities.signal: Alert armed - deploy AT the 5.20% gate only
